title: Gecko babillard son MHNT
author: Roger Culos
changes: Real recording of a common barking gecko (Ptenopus garrulus) calling in Damaraland, Namibia, used for the tuatara: tuatara almost never call and no free recording of their rare croak exists, so this is a gecko, a lizard from tuatara's closest living relatives (lizards and snakes). Trimmed to 0.78–2.62 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
